description: Tuiscotti external Renovate config (G7): Cargo + Mise + Rust-toolchain only, dashboard on, bounded concurrency, weekly lockfile maintenance, no automerge.

packageRules.description: Terminal backend boundary: termpane updates always land alone for focused review.
Renderer/font/codec stack: pixel-sensitive, review together but apart from low-risk batches.
Rust toolchain and Mise tool pins stay consistent; MSRV (rust-version) bumps remain manual and ride review on these PRs.
Pre-1.0 crates can break on minor bumps; keep them out of the low-risk batch.
Major bumps for stable crates get their own PRs, never batched silently.
